name: L10-the-hunt
_notes: The demo level for the enemies-and-objects pass, and the one the pack keeps as a reference for what each new thing is for. **A one-way shelf** (row 11, columns 12-18) is the only way across the first pit: it is ground from above and air from below, so the jump up through it and the landing on top are one move. **A flyer** (row 8, a twelve-tile beat over the whole first pit) makes the crossing a timing problem rather than a jump. **A chaser** (column 26) hunts along the middle ledge and stops at its edge instead of falling in. **A turret** (column 31, facing left) makes that ledge's row dangerous on a clock, so the answer is a route that spends as little time on it as possible. **A moving platform** (columns 35-37, sliding four tiles right) is the shortcut across the last five-tile pit, which a sprint jump also clears: the oracle does not model a mover, so a level that needed one would read unbeatable, and the demo has to be beatable without it.
